messages:
Neel Patel: Morning! Quick onboarding check — Day 3. What I did: got laptop imaged, installed VS Code + extensions, created GitLab account, cloned monorepo. Blockers: SSH key not loading with `ssh-agent`, getting "Agent admitted failure to sign" on pushes; Git LFS failing on large model weights (401). Today: try to get SSH agent working, ask infra for registry token, start basic runtime tutorial.

Aisha (onboarding): Hey Neel — welcome! For ssh-agent on Mac, try: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you're on Linux, use `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. For the agent error can you paste `ssh -vT git@gitlab.redwood-inference.com` output? Also filing a ticket for Git LFS.

Neel Patel: thanks — running `ssh -vT git@gitlab.redwood-inference.com` now, output shows permission denied (publickey). I added the key to GitLab web UI, but maybe wrong format.

Jordan Lee: @Neel quick ping — we use GitLab self-hosted; the Git URL should be `git@gitlab.redwood-inference.com:team/repo.git`. Are you trying github.com? Also for internal repos make sure you have SSO OKTA session active — that can cause 401 for LFS.

Neel Patel: ah, that explains it — I did use github.com by habit. Switching remote now.

infra-bot: Incident #3201 created: git-lfs auth failures for new hires. Assigned to infra-access. Link: https://issues.redwood-inference.com/3201

Maya R.: @Neel re: SSH agent on macOS Ventura, we moved to using `gpg-agent` in some cases. If `ssh-add -K` fails, try `brew install keychain` + `keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and add `eval $(keychain --eval id_ed25519)` to your `~/.zshrc`.

Neel Patel: Updated remote and retried `git lfs pull` — now getting 200 but slow. LFS still times out sometimes; Aisha, what's the expected bootstrap steps? Should I use a smaller sample model for the runtime tutorial?

Aisha (onboarding): Yes please use the tiny-rw-model sample in `examples/runtime/small` for the tutorial. We'll add a note to the playbook about LFS throttling. For now infra will whitelist your pipeline job.

Jordan Lee: If you need a temporary token I can generate a scoped CI token for you — DM me and I'll set expiry to 24h.

Neel Patel: Awesome, will DM. No other blockers for now. Thanks all! :tada:
